subject: Prevent multi-loop double-dispatch: add acquireSpawnLease + dedupe/GC the loop registry
description:
Multiple active heartbeat loops hand out the SAME ready task in one tick, causing redundant worker spawns (observed 2026-06-15: loops 17bcfbd6 + 768f14c2 both returned 9195fb5e/2 and d236bffd/3). CAS at start_task (task ce0b4fd0/17) prevents two workers from BOTH completing — the loser gets 409 — so correctness is safe; the harm is wasted spawn tokens. Two-part fix:

PART A — per-task SPAWN lease (the real gap). The spawn block in daemon.js (~L1003-1022) dedupes across loops only by a shared COUNT (ctx.batch.remaining); every loop computes the same `ready` array and does ready.slice(0, take), so the first two loops pick IDENTICAL tasks. The eager-judge path already does this right (daemon.js:966-968 via overlayStore.acquireEagerJudgeLease, lib/overlay.js:806). Mirror it for spawn:
  1. Add acquireSpawnLease(overlay, taskKey, loopId, ttlMs) to lib/overlay.js — a copy of acquireEagerJudgeLease keyed on overlay.spawnLease (check leaseExpiry>now, return false if held). Add clearSpawnLease too.
  2. In the spawn block: BEFORE slicing, filter `ready` to tasks with no live spawn lease; then for each of the `take` selected tasks, acquireSpawnLease(ov, t.id, L.id, ttl) before returning them.
  3. Release the lease on start_task claim (success) AND on completion/failure; TTL (~60s) is the safety net for crashed/abandoned spawns so a leased-but-never-claimed task frees up.
  Add a test mirroring the eager-judge lease test: two concurrent next_action calls in one tick must return DISJOINT spawn task sets.

PART B — loop registry leak (root cause of the contention). loop_control({action:"start"}) mints a fresh UUID loop every call and never clobbers/GCs, so dead loops accumulate (153 live in registry on 2026-06-15: 143 inactive, 111 born-dead with iters=0; ~444k tokens spent cumulatively). Fix:
  1. On action:"start", if the caller's `session` already has a live loop, REUSE it (return existing loopId) instead of minting a new one — dedupe per session.
  2. Add GC: prune active:false loop entries from the registry (loops Map + loops.json, daemon.js ~L290/L363) on a sweep or on boot, keeping maybe the last N for history.
  Net: ~1 active loop per session instead of 10, which removes most spawn contention even before Part A.

Both are live-daemon changes (lib/overlay.js, daemon.js) requiring a daemon restart to take effect. Acceptance: with >1 active loop, a single heartbeat tick never returns the same task key to two loops; registry does not grow unbounded across repeated start calls from one session.
